entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor Server: EventCallback on child pagination component does not invoke parent handler in specific page context #65892
  • ManagedAuthenticatedEncryptor is broken on NETFX #65889
  • `==` and `!=` operators produce strange results for bound parameters #65886
  • jQuery on NuGet is still v3.7.1 even though 4.0.0 is the latest #65879
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-noop, antiforgery-validation #65878

Closed

  • [OpenAPI] Cannot skip SecurityScheme for controllers with [AllowAnonymous] #61264
    Backlog

    Backlog

    Backlog

    11.0-preview3
